_about: Public-domain Angela of Foligno (1248-1309, Franciscan tertiary) in English for the Word Hoard: The Book of Divine Consolation, tr. Mary G. Steegmann with an introduction by Algar Thorold (London, 1909), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 25 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
